description: Core thread primitives and thread creation functions for ARCv2 architecture in Zephyr RTOS, including stack setup, context initialization, and optional DSP and user space support.

methods.name: setup_stack_vars
methods.description: Sets stack-related variables for a thread, handling user and privileged stacks.

methods.name: get_iframe
methods.description: Retrieves the initial stack frame pointer for a thread, considering user space.

methods.name: arch_setup_callee_saved_regs
methods.description: Pre-populates register values in the callee-saved stack for a new thread.

methods.name: arch_new_thread
methods.description: Initializes a new thread's stack and context, setting up the initial stack frame and register states.

methods.name: z_arch_get_next_switch_handle
methods.description: Returns the next thread switch handle, depending on multithreading configuration.

methods.name: arch_user_mode_enter
methods.description: Enters user mode for a thread, setting up the user space environment.

methods.name: arch_float_disable
methods.description: Disables floating point registers for a thread.

methods.name: arch_float_enable
methods.description: Enables floating point registers for a thread.

methods.name: z_arc_switch_to_main_no_multithreading
methods.description: Starts the main thread in a non-multithreaded environment.

methods.name: arc_dsp_disable
methods.description: Disables DSP capabilities for a thread.

methods.name: arc_dsp_enable
methods.description: Enables DSP capabilities for a thread.
